_comment: Unpredictable Cyclone phase 3: the SEARCHED cycle (a cycle seed plan action) under Unpredictable Cyclone.
Round 3, main 1, land drop made, Cyclone + three Islands out, Street Wraith in hand; the library top is
Island, Emrakul. Cycling the Wraith (pay 2 life) REPLACES the draw: the walk exiles the Island, finds
Emrakul (a creature, like the Wraith), casts it free -- a real cast, so its trigger grants an extra turn
-- and Emrakul attacks for 15 in that extra turn: the 15-life opponent dies in ROUND 3 (extra turns do
not count). No other line wins by round 5 (the Wraith cannot be hard-cast off Islands).
